title: Ganesha ki Buddhi aur Mallikarjun ki Kahani
hooks: Kartikeya poori duniya ghoomne nikal gaye, par Ganesha ne bina hile race kaise jeet li?
Kya Maa-Baap ke charno mein poori duniya basi hai? Ganesha ne ye sach kar dikhaya.
Mallikarjun Jyotirlinga kaise bana? Iske peeche hai bhaiyon ki ek anokhi race.
hook_why: It creates immediate curiosity about the 'how' and uses a relatable competitive scenario between brothers.

caption:
Ganesha ki buddhi ya Kartikeya ki raftar? 🙏

Jaaniye Mallikarjun Jyotirlinga ki ye adbhut katha jahan Ganesha ne bataya ki Mata-Pita hi asli duniya hain.

Kya aapne kabhi Srisailam ke darshan kiye hain?

claims.claim: Mallikarjun is one of the 12 Jyotirlingas.
claims.basis: Shiva Purana and established Hindu tradition.

claims.claim: The story involves a race between Ganesha and Kartikeya.
The temple is located in Srisailam, Andhra Pradesh.

figures.name: Kartikeya
figures.look: Youthful warrior god with six radiant faces, athletic build, glowing golden skin. Wears ornate silk dhoti, peacock-feather crown, and golden armlets. Holds a glowing vel spear. Accompanied by a magnificent, vibrant peacock with iridescent feathers.

figures.name: Ganesha
figures.look: Elephant-headed deity, one broken tusk, stout pot-bellied build, four arms holding a modak. Wears a bright yellow silk dhoti and heavy gold necklaces. Accompanied by a small, humble mouse as his loyal vehicle.

figures.name: Shiva
figures.look: Ash-grey skin, athletic build, matted hair adorned with a crescent moon and flowing Ganga. Third eye on forehead, trident and damru in hands, snake coiled around neck, tiger skin draped over waist.

figures.name: Parvati
figures.look: Graceful goddess, youthful, almond-shaped eyes, radiant skin. Wears a rich red silk saree with intricate gold embroidery, heavy gold temple jewellery, and jasmine flowers in her dark, flowing hair.

figures.name: Shiva as Arjun
figures.look: Hunter form, tanned skin, athletic build, simple leaf garments covering the waist. Holds a wooden bow and arrow. Hair tied in a simple knot, humble posture, serene expression, divine light surrounding his form.

figures.name: Parvati as Mallika
figures.look: Tribal woman, youthful, radiant skin. Wears simple earthy-toned fabric, jasmine flowers woven into her hair, and minimal wooden jewellery. Standing with a graceful, humble posture beside Arjun, radiating a gentle, divine aura.

places.name: Kailash
places.look: Majestic, snow-capped mountain peak, glowing with warm golden divine light. Features a natural stone throne carved into the rock, surrounded by soft, swirling clouds and an ethereal, painterly divine atmosphere.

places.name: Krauncha Mountain
places.look: High, rocky, misty mountain peak. Atmospheric, vertical composition with sharp crags and swirling white clouds. Soft, dim light highlighting the rugged texture of the stone, creating a sense of deep solitude and grandeur.

places.name: Mallikarjun Temple
places.look: Majestic temple architecture in Srisailam, intricate stone carvings, golden sunset light bathing the structure. Sanctum contains the linga adorned with white jasmine garlands and a small golden bow. Serene, divine, and ancient atmosphere.
